items.question: What net revenue was attributed to each campaign for orders in 2026, by campaign name?

SELECT c.name AS campaign_name, SUM(o.net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue o
JOIN campaigns c ON o.campaign_id = c.id
WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC;

items.question: What was the average resolution time in hours of support tickets by region in 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT
    r.code AS region_code,
    r.name AS region_name,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM st.resolved_at - st.created_at) / 3600), 2) AS avg_resolution_hours
FROM
    support_tickets st
JOIN
    regions r ON st.region_id = r.id
WHERE
    st.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND st.created_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    r.id,
    r.code,
    r.name
ORDER BY
    avg_resolution_hours DESC;

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql:
SELECT
  region_code,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q2_net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q3_net_revenue,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 2
  ) AS revenue_diff,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END), 0), 4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM order_revenue
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY region_code
ORDER BY q3_net_revenue DESC;

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT
    region_code,
    region_name,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS q2_2026_orders,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01') AS q3_2026_orders,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01')) AS order_count_diff,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01') = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'))::numeric / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01')
        END, 4
    ) AS pct_change
FROM order_revenue
WHERE (order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01')
   OR (order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01')
GROUP BY region_code, region_name
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: What was the refund rate in each region in 2025 compared with 2026 so far?
items.sql:
SELECT
    region_code,
    ROUND(refund_2025 / NULLIF(gross_2025, 0), 4) AS refund_rate_2025,
    ROUND(refund_2026 / NULLIF(gross_2026, 0), 4) AS refund_rate_2026,
    ROUND((refund_2026 / NULLIF(gross_2026, 0)) - (refund_2025 / NULLIF(gross_2025, 0)), 4) AS difference,
    ROUND(((refund_2026 / NULLIF(gross_2026, 0)) - (refund_2025 / NULLIF(gross_2025, 0))) / NULLIF(refund_2025 / NULLIF(gross_2025, 0), 0), 4) AS pct_change
FROM (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN refund_usd ELSE 0 END) AS refund_2025,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN gross_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS gross_2025,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN refund_usd ELSE 0 END) AS refund_2026,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN gross_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS gross_2026
    FROM order_revenue
    GROUP BY region_code
) sub
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: Which customers placed the most orders in 2025? Show the top 5, including anyone tied with the fifth.
items.sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM customer_profile c
    JOIN order_revenue o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' 
      AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        order_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_id) AS rn
    FROM customer_orders
)
SELECT 
    co.customer_id,
    co.customer_name,
    co.order_count
FROM customer_orders co
JOIN ordered o ON co.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE co.order_count >= (
    SELECT order_count 
    FROM ordered 
    WHERE rn = 5
)
ORDER BY co.order_count DESC, co.customer_name;

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?
items.sql:
WITH jan_2025_first_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_order_at
  FROM customer_profile
  WHERE first_order_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND first_order_at < DATE '2025-02-01'
),
second_order_dates AS (
  SELECT
    j.customer_id,
    j.first_order_at,
    MIN(o.ordered_at) AS second_order_at
  FROM jan_2025_first_customers j
  JOIN order_revenue o
    ON o.customer_id = j.customer_id
   AND o.ordered_at > j.first_order_at
  GROUP BY j.customer_id, j.first_order_at
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_ordered_again_within_90_days
FROM second_order_dates
WHERE second_order_at <= first_order_at + INTERVAL '90 days';

items.question: What share of customers who signed up in 2024 placed at least one order in 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT cp.customer_id) AS total_signups_2024,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01') AS customers_with_order_2026,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01')::numeric /
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.customer_id),
    4
  ) AS share
FROM customer_profile cp
LEFT JOIN order_revenue o ON cp.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE cp.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND cp.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01';

items.question: Among products with at least 100 units sold in 2025, which one had the highest refund rate?
items.sql:
SELECT
  product_name,
  SUM(units) AS units_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(refund_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 0), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM order_line_revenue
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
HAVING SUM(units) >= 100
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

items.question: At which local hour of the day did APAC customers place the most orders in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AS local_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
JOIN regions ON orders.region_id = regions.id
WHERE regions.code = 'APAC'
  AND ordered_at >= '2025-01-01'::timestamp
  AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'::timestamp
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY local_hour
ORDER BY order_count DESC;
